---
format: html
html-table-processing: none
---

A scratch space for trying out tinytab interactively: run the cells one at a time in your editor
(Positron, VS Code), or render the whole file with `make playground`. Nothing here is
part of the package or the tests, so edit freely.

Tables show up as HTML here because `Table` has a `_repr_html_()` method.

```{python}
from tinytab import Table, fmt_currency, fmt_number, fmt_percent, summarize

menu = Table(
    {
        "item": ["coffee", "bagel", "croissant"],
        "price": [3.5, 2.25, 4.0],
        "sold": [120, 45, None],
    }
)

menu.fmt("price", fmt_currency)
```

```{python}
print(menu.fmt("price", fmt_currency).as_text())
```

```{python}
fmt_number(1234567.891), fmt_percent(0.256), fmt_currency(-5, currency="GBP")
```

```{python}
summarize([0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
```
